What should the skill be called? We recommend galley, after the galley proofs an author marks up in the margins and signs off before printing. Alternatives are margin-call and say-so. If unanswered: galley.

What does accepting mean when some questions are still open? We recommend that accept means done answering. Unanswered questions take their recommended default. The skill's reply to the accept lists them. If unanswered: as recommended.

How do you accept or send a doc back? We recommend a new top-level comment on the title starting Approved, Accept or LGTM. A comment starting Changes: asks for a revision. If unanswered: as recommended.

Should the implementation plan and execution wait for approval too? We recommend they do not wait for approval. Questions that come up after the spec is accepted go to a separate implementation-questions doc. Work continues on each question's recommendation. If unanswered: not gated.
Should galley keep marginalia's companion and explainer docs? We recommend dropping them, because answers go into the proposal or spec doc itself. If unanswered: dropped.

How often should galley check for comments when you are quiet? We recommend the cron checks every 20 minutes and backs off to hourly after a day without comments. It never auto-accepts. If unanswered: as recommended.

Should sdd's inconsistencies be fixed in the same change? For example, its finishing step stops the loop with ScheduleWakeup instead of CronDelete. We recommend fixing them in the same change. If unanswered: fixed.

How should active reading time be measured? Google Docs reports comments and edits but not views. We recommend inferring it from your comment bursts: a session runs from first to last comment with gaps under 10 minutes, plus a fixed lead-in per session, calibrated against the estimates over time. If unanswered: as recommended.
